description: Live job listings from Indeed and Glassdoor (plus Google Jobs, ZipRecruiter) in 30 countries for a job title and location: up to 50 jobs with company, salary, job type, remote flag, date posted and links, plus a summary (salary range per year, top employers, remote share). Costs $0.10 per call, paid in USDC on Base with x402.
